Class Persona

  • java.lang.Object
    • clases.Persona
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    Usuario

    public class Persona
extends java.lang.Object
    The person class is designed in order to identify the types of people, whether teacher or student, and has its variables that are inherited in both the teacher and student class.
